column1: # Requirements proven by review, not by a test: the requirement, a tab, how it is verified.

column2: Paths are built with path.join; no code of this spec starts a process, and every network call is spec 109's (a time limit each). CI runs the suite on both boot-machine platforms and as a user who is not root: .github/workflows/ci.yml job "check" (Bun and Node) and job "suite" (matrix windows-latest, macos-latest); the tests that sign commits carry { timeout: 180_000 }, and the tests use the sandbox's git identity file (GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL).

The four checks and compat:digest --check run in bun run ci with baselines that do not grow; this change adds no line to tools/mizan.baseline.txt, trace.baseline.txt or layers.baseline.txt, and does not touch src/archon/model/types.ts or site.ts.
